confidence.reason: Image reference and deployment wiring are explicit in source; registry mutation timing was not observed in this source-only run.

description: The compose deployment pins postgres and Caddy images but tracks cloudflared through the mutable cloudflare/cloudflared:latest tag. A rebuild or redeploy can therefore silently change the edge tunnel binary without a source change or review.

evidence.description: cloudflared service uses the mutable latest tag while warning that pinning matters.
Same file pins postgres to postgres:16-alpine.
Same file pins Caddy to caddy:2-alpine.
Runtime backend image pins exact dependency versions for reproducible deploys.

execution.attacker_perspective: Operator/supply-chain observer reviewing reproducible deployment inputs.
instructions: Inspect compose.yml image references for the edge tunnel versus postgres and Caddy.
Rebuild or redeploy at two different times and record the resolved cloudflared digest.
Observe that the tunnel image can change without any repository change.
Confirm that no digest pin or update-review step constrains the edge binary.
execution.observed_result: The tunnel image reference is mutable: redeploys can silently change edge software while the repository remains unchanged.

intended_behavior: Public-edge deployment inputs should be pinned and reviewable so rebuilds do not silently change tunnel software.

code_changes.fixed_code: image: cloudflare/cloudflared:2026.9.1  # replace with the reviewed/tested release and update deliberately, or pin by digest.

remediation.strategy: Pin cloudflared to a tested version or digest and update it through deliberate dependency changes, matching the treatment of postgres and Caddy.

root_cause: Mutable latest image tag for the Cloudflare Tunnel edge container.

impact.reason: Edge software can change silently; no direct credential disclosure or tenant compromise is demonstrated by the tag alone.

likelihood.reason: Requires an upstream image change coinciding with redeploy; routine rebuilds make this plausible over time.

title: Cloudflared edge image uses mutable latest tag

trace.description: Deployment entry: container image selection for the public edge.
Mutable tag selects whatever latest resolves to at deploy time.
No digest or version pin constrains the resolved edge artifact.
